## 2026-05-15

### Impact

- **Manage Actions: API change** — `Transact.presentAction()` and `ActionConfig` have been removed. Customers running Manage actions should now call `Transact.present()` directly with a regular `Config`. The SDK detects headless action tasks from the config and skips showing the WebView UI automatically.

### Changes

- Removed `Transact.presentAction()` and `ActionConfig`; use `Transact.present()` with `Config` for Manage actions
- Fixed headless action detection so it works for token-based configs
- Fixed the public token injection into `window.__TRANSACT_PUBLIC_TOKEN__` for encoded Transact configs (#185, #186)

### Products

- Deposit
- Switch
- Manage

### Requirements

#### Latest

| Name       | Compatible | Build Version |
| ---------- | ---------- | ------------- |
| Kotlin     | 2.0+       | 2.1.21        |
| Gradle     | 8.7+       | 8.7           |
| AGP        | 8.6+       | 8.6.1         |
| Min SDK    | 23         | 23            |
| Target SDK | 35         | 35            |

#### Legacy (`-kotlin1.9`)

| Name       | Compatible | Build Version |
| ---------- | ---------- | ------------- |
| Kotlin     | 1.9.x      | 1.9.25        |
| Gradle     | 8.0+       | 8.7           |
| AGP        | 8.1 - 8.5  | 8.1.4         |
| Min SDK    | 23         | 23            |
| Target SDK | 35         | 35            |
